info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Credit Rating Update API
info.description: The Customer Credit Rating Update API enables financial institutions to manage and adjust customer credit ratings effectively. This API supports operations to update credit ratings based on user-defined criteria such as changes in financial behavior or circumstances. Typically used by banking and financial services professionals, this API facilitates proactive credit management and risk assessment. Integrating this functionality can enhance customer relationships and improve credit risk strategies.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the credit rating information for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to successfully modify the customer's credit rating record.

requestBody.description: Updates the credit rating information for the specified customer. Ensure that all fields provided in the request body are in the correct format and that any necessary validations are adhered to.

200.description: Successfully updated the customer credit rating.
